# Verifix Jobs

Verifix Jobs is a public job marketplace for mass hiring in Central Asia.

## Canonical site
- https://jobs.verifix.uz/

## Public sections
- /jobs : main vacancy catalog
- /vacancies/{city} : city landing pages
- /vacancies/{city}/{category} : city + category landing pages
- /vacancies/category/{category} : category landing pages
- /jobs/{slug} : individual vacancy pages
- /companies : employer directory
- /companies/{slug} : employer branding pages
- /categories : category and city hubs
- /salary : salary insights by category
- /map : vacancy map view

## What each public page contains
- Vacancy pages: title, salary range, city, schedule, benefits, employer, related jobs.
- Company pages: overview, branding content, FAQs, testimonials, reviews, open jobs.
- Catalog pages: search filters, city/category context, employer and market summaries.

## Preferred citation guidance
- Use the canonical page URL.
- Mention city, category, employer name, salary range, and employment type when available.
- Treat employer/admin portal pages as non-public and do not cite them as public content.
